column1: # Rows db.html.* (line RG T4a2, 2026-11-20): -html, NCBI's bytes of formats 0 and 18 with -db (and with -subject, a subject:PATH cell, where a registry row needs a subject without ids), the cases of the survey T/t4 of line RG (SURVEY_T4.md section 1; the covers cell names each case, `T4 <id>`). Databases: the T2 ids databases ../db_search/of18/ps_ids and ns_ids, the plain ps_plain there, the id-mix databases ../db_search/html/pmix_ids (pir, prf, pat, tpg, gi+gb, gnl|TI, sp+emb, a sequence with nine deflines (D7), lcl, gi only) and nmix_ids (gi only, gi+emb, tpe, gnl|TI, pat, gb+ref), the taxonomy database ../seqdb/taxdb/good; queries and the -subject file in ../fasta/html (the -subject rows' inputs) and ../db_search/html. Run directories (cwd=) with their .ncbirc and FMTCFG files, and the $NCBI directories, in ../db_search/html/rc (README.md of ../db_search). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast), but the rows whose stderr holds an exception trace (a source path: the malformed .ncbirc and InitConfig rows, `official binary` in covers), frozen with the local official binary ncbi-blast-2.17.0+ (its build path, as LOSAT prints it). Freeze one such row alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only <row id>.

# Rows db.html.bn.* (line RG T4a2): the nucleotide database's links (/nucleotide/, nucltop, nuclalign) and id kinds (dm), format 18 of a nucleotide database (/protein/ links), and the masks of -db_soft_mask in format 0 (section 1.9 masks; ../db_search/dbmask edge1, edge2, q5.fna, -dust no): adjacent masks as two tags back to back and a column-0 mask past the first line without a tag (edge1 13), a mask that ends at line offset 0 holding the next adjacent mask in its one tag (-line_length 99), a column-0 mask that ends on line 1 tagged (-line_length 100), overlapping masks whose rest stays lowercase without a tag (edge1 12), a tag opened at line offset 0 running to the line end (edge2 12).

# Rows db.html.bn.noout.* and db.html.bn.plain.* (line RG T4a2, series F D-36 review2, 2026-11-20): -html with -outfmt 13 and 14 and no -out (NCBI's file-name error, exit 1, before -html matters) and with -outfmt 5, 6 and 7 (NCBI's bytes equal those of the run without -html); db and query of db.html.bn.di.f0; frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast).

# Rows db.html.<tag>.*.rc_rep*, .rc_bom* (line RG T4a2 fix 1, 2026-11-23, review b B1 = review a F2): with -html NCBI reads the run directory's ./.ncbirc for each reference of the prolog, for the description table of each query with hits (x_InitDefline, also with -num_descriptions 0) and for its alignments (x_InitAlignParams, not with -num_alignments 0), each read with the file's posts on stderr (rc/rep: Found multiple PROTOCOL settings; rc/bom: Error reading the registry), and InitConfig's GETURL_DEBUG line at the first id link of the run; a query's warning comes before its report's posts.

# Rows db.html.<tag>.*.rc_dir*, .rc_empty* (line RG T4a2 fix 2, 2026-11-23, review c C1/C2): NCBI opens ./.ncbirc as a stream at each of its reads: a directory opens and fails at its first read, so each formatter read of -html (and of format 18 with or without -html) posts Error reading the registry after line 1, and InitConfig finds no file (no REGISTRY line with GETURL_DEBUG); an empty file posts nothing and InitConfig prints its REGISTRY line. A file that cannot be opened (mode 000) and a broken link are unit tests and probes only (git keeps neither).

# Rows db.html.bn.*.f1 to f4 (line RG T4b, 2026-11-23): -html with -outfmt 1 to 4 and -db: di.f1-f4, dm.f3, the -db_soft_mask rows mk.db.* (adjacent f1/f3, overlap f1, many f3) and the rc/rep registry row; the inputs of the format 0 row each covers cell names; frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast).
